name: Let's Make a Deal
description: Audience members dress up in outlandish costumes to get host Wayne Brady's attention in an attempt to make deals for trips, prizes, cars or cash, while trying to avoid the dreaded Zonks.

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2022 Episode 1
videos.overview: Prizes include trips to Portugal, Croatia, and Greece, a Mercedes-Benz SUV, and a 2022 Lamborghini Huracan EVO Spider, worth over $347,000. At least one trader is guaranteed to win $50,000 in cash.

Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023 Episode 1
videos.overview: Let's Make a Deal Primetime returns and is packed with all of the deluxe getaways, including luxury trips to the Maldives, Bora Bora, Bali, Ibiza, Hawaii, Jamaica, and more. Then, everyone will feel those vacation vibes with a special performance from Shaggy! Plus, one trader will win $50,000 and another could win an unbelievable seven-continent tour.

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023 Episode 2
videos.overview: Tonight LMAD Primetime presents a salute to the military. The audience is filled with active and retired men and women who have served our country - some even playing virtually from around the world. To thank the service men and women, LET'S MAKE A DEAL is giving away the biggest amount of cash and prizes in the series' history! Plus, special guest Jordin Sparks shows her appreciation by singing a prize clue with Wayne.

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023  Episode 3
videos.overview: Packing an entire week's worth of daily daytime episodes into one special night, starting with a Mega Money Monday $25,000 guaranteed win! Tiffany unveils her food truck to celebrate Taco Tuesday, complete with a special taco stuffed with a hidden prize. Luxury travel takes center stage on Worldwide Wednesday with a dream vacation to Japan, Thailand and Singapore.

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023 Episode 4
videos.overview: LET'S MAKE A DEAL PRIMETIME celebrates its season finale with big prizes and even bigger winners in some of the show's most iconic deals and games, including Dr. Wayne, Accelerator and the new classic, Jewel Heist. Lucky traders could win $30,000 in cash, trips to Spain, Switzerland and the Dominican Republic, along with an electric Ford Mustang, a Genesis G70 and even a Bentley!

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023 Episode 5
Let's Make a Deal Primetime 2023 Episode 6
videos.overview: With prizes like a BMW X1, a trip to Greece, and a 7 Wonders of the World tour, it truly is a WONDERful episode of LMAD: Primetime! Plus, a DIY Diva hopes to go 0 to 80 for a new Genesis and a couple tries to figure out "how much is enough", hoping for a honeymoon after 23 years of marriage.

videos.title: Let's Make a Deal 2023 Primetime Episode 7
videos.overview: A LMAD with no Zonks? One can hope! A couple tries to match "3 of a Kind" for a new Lexus. Then, a classic TV character plays "Dice Checks" for a chance at $25,000! Plus, a student hopes to match with a prize in "The Dealing Game"!

Let’s Make a Deal is back for lucky Season 13! This year, every Monday is Mega Money Monday, and we’re kicking things off in a big way! Special guest, Drew Barrymore is trying to give away $20,000! Wayne Brady hosts.
Go for a Season 13 spin with an all new episode of LMAD! Dr. Wayne is back to help a couple win BIG! Plus, a cowboy, a pirate & a nanny try to Beat the Dealer, and a Burger is looking for some bling!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Are you ready to party America?! DJ Tiffany “Elbows” Coyne is in the house! Plus, an astronaut blasts off into a fierce “Debate” & a showgirl makes a deal from home! Hosted by Wayne Brady.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Put a monkey on your head and swing it to the left, good luck! A flower plays "Gold Rush" from home for a car! Plus, Wayne and Jonathan sings clues from the LMAD Jukebox, Tiffany gets a protege.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: A new LMAD that's tre magnifique! A 50's housewife tries to win a car playing "Accelerator". Then, a trekkie hopes to "remember when" movies came out to win $15,000! Plus, "Jonathan Bighead" gives prize clues & book fairy plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: It's a new LMAD that sizzles! A mermaid hopes to win a new car, playing "Gold Rush." Then, a pharoah and bacon draw pictures for cash. Plus, Wayne & Jonathan give clues in their "LMAD podcast" & a cowboy plays "Red or Black" from home.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: It's Mega Mummy...we mean Money Monday! One trader plays "Accelerator" for a car & 3 more try to "beat the dealer" to win $10,000. Plus, Cleopatra gets some prize clues "in so many words," Tiffany gets a protege & a Sushi Roll makes a deal from home.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: The new LMAD is a wild one! A gladiator play "Tic Tac Deal" for a car. Plus, An apple tries to match with a prize in "The Dealing Game", a rainbow angel hopes to "go the distance" to win 3 trips, & three traders visit the "Expanding Gift Card".

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: A new LMAD for all the fans! An astronaut, a leprechaun, & a medieval maiden "draw straws" for cash. Then, Wayne & Jonathan perform deleted movie scenes to give prize clues. Plus, a trader plays "Gold Rush" from home. & a pirate gets a blank check.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: The 80s called & said this new LMAD is totally tubular! A banana races to the finish, trying to win a new car & a mad scientist plays "Dice Checks" for another. Plus, Wayne & Jonathan give prize clues in an 80s rock song & a hockey referee plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: It's a new LMAD with deals of steel! An art teacher rolls dice, hoping to move on up to a new car! Then, a penguin visits Tiffany's Court". Plus, 3 traders try to make a "power play" for cash and prizes & a fitness instructor plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Sink your teeth into a new LMAD! A potted plant takes her chances with the "LMAD Lotto" to win a car & a disco diva races for another! Plus, Jonathan and Tiffany deliver some "Breaking News" filled with prize clues & a tiger plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: It's no illusion! It really is a new LMAD! Mr. Zonk Clean spins the "Accelerator" wheel for a car. Then, a marine, a hippie, & a grape goddess put "Numbers Up" for cash. Plus, a card shark makes some magic with Wayne & an alien plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Worldwide Wednesday is back on a new LMAD! A dinosaur rider & a tourist try to spell "winner" for an amazing trip. Then, a pharoah goes for a spin, hoping to win a car for grandma. Plus, Wayne & Jonathan perform a deleted movie scene to give prize clues.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: This new LMAD is the one that I want! A banana tries to smash for $20,000 cash and a stack of pancakes plays "Five Card Wayne" for a car. Plus, 3 trader hope their ticket jackets have dream trips inside and Dr. Wayne makes an appearance.

videos.title: Episode 63

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Beep Beep! The bus stops at a new LMAD! A bus driver gets a "30 second theater" clue from Wayne & Jonathan. Plus, a couple plays "Draw Me a Deal", a tough cookie tries to "move on up" to a car, & a cheetah hopes to win from home.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: The new LMAD kind of rocks! A dentist "races to the finish" for a car and more! Then, a cat, a vampire, & a greek goddess try to make a prize "power play." Plus, another trader visits the characters of "Tiffany's Court" & a cowgirl plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Holy Cow! It's a new LMAD! Jonathan Bigheads meets a pirate & her parrot. Then, a butterfly, a magician, & a skeleton visit the "Wishing Well." Plus, a cow, a grandma & an artistic chicken put "Numbers Up" for cash & a couple plays from home.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Christmas starts early at LMAD with presents stuffed with prizes, a ride on the "Cash Train," & visit from "Dr. Wayne". Plus, an ornament tries to "keep on rollin" to a holiday trip or a car.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Celebrate Christmas Eve Eve with a new LMAD! A trader opens the Christmas countdown calendar. Then, Wayne writes his letter to Santa & a Wise Man plays "Car Pong" for a new holiday ride. Plus, a Caroler tries to smash for some Christmas cash.
